prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, logo-brand.
Adapt this exact approved delicate runner logo into the compact primary symbol for a mobile app.
Preserve the existing mature adult athlete EXACTLY: same graceful running posture, small tilted oval outline head, anatomical proportions, both arms, flexed front knee, extended back leg, and smooth thin consistent monoline. Do not redesign the runner and do not make a cartoon or stick-figure pictogram.
Change only the ECG extensions and composition:
1. REMOVE the entire ECG pulse and long horizontal line to the LEFT of the runner. Terminate the back foot naturally with one short smooth rounded end, with no baseline tail.
2. On the RIGHT of the front foot, retain only ONE tiny simple ECG up-down pulse integrated into the foot, with a very short terminal. Make this tiny pulse secondary, no taller than half the head height. Remove all extra wave bumps and long horizontal tails.
3. Re-center the complete runner plus this single small pulse on a SQUARE transparent canvas. The resulting silhouette is almost square, around 1.1:1, rather than a wide horizontal strip. The athlete occupies approximately 70% of the canvas height, with balanced generous margins and room for circular app-icon masks. Shift optical centering very slightly left if necessary to balance the small pulse.
Uniform delicate geometric monoline, approximately 20px at 1024px canvas scale, steady thickness throughout, rounded joins and clean rounded terminals. No tapered brush ends, no thick wedges or fills, no inner decoration. Preserve the runner's anatomical line flow.
Keep a smooth restrained cyan #20D8F8 to blue #2F7EF6 left-to-right gradient applied only to the symbol. Truly transparent RGBA background and all inner spaces transparent. No background tile, no border, no shadow, no glow, no texture, no lighting or 3D.
No words, lettering, initials, numbers, annotations, grids, presentation boards, watermarks or extra symbols. Exactly one compact refined runner-plus-small-pulse app symbol.
